## Checklist

Check each item once you have done it, and remove the items that don’t apply to this pull request.

- [ ] Start the PR title with a Conventional Commit prefix, [as explained here](https://github.com/Amsterdam/design-system/blob/main/documentation/publishing.md#conventional-commits)
- [ ] Add or update unit tests
- [ ] Add or update documentation
- [ ] Add or update stories
- [ ] Add or update exports in `index.*` files
- [ ] Comment `/chromatic test` and verify visual regression tests pass
- [ ] Test manually with screen readers, at least the first two, as the [definition of done](https://github.com/Amsterdam/design-system/blob/main/documentation/definition-of-done.md#required-accessibility-checks) requires:
  - [ ] NVDA and Chrome on Windows
  - [ ] VoiceOver and Safari on macOS or iOS
  - [ ] TalkBack or Voice Assistant (Samsung) on Android
- [ ] Ask a designer to review the design
